evidence.why: Defines the signature, operational cases, default branch, and interrupt restoration.

facts.rationale: Corrects the incomplete enum-domain description while preserving the verified signature and operational policy meanings.
facts.value: Signature: void HSD_PadFlushQueue(HSD_FlushType ftype). HSD_FlushType declares MERGE, THROWAWAY, LEAVE1, and TERMINATE enumerators with the HSD_PAD_FLUSH_QUEUE_ prefix. The first three select queue-reduction policies; TERMINATE has no dedicated case and follows the default no-op path, with interrupt state still restored.

facts.rationale: The reset body invokes list removal and OffN; OffN changes direct_status rather than calling PADControlMotor.
facts.value: Resets HSD controller bookkeeping by removing scheduled rumble, clearing direct rumble requests for four ports, discarding queued samples, requesting all-channel PAD recalibration, and clearing the reset-switch latch. It does not directly command the motors.

evidence.why: THROWAWAY sets qread to qwrite and qcount to zero.

facts.rationale: Distinguishes immediate writes from conditional downstream calibration.
facts.value: With no caller data, reset removes four ports' scheduled rumble lists, writes zero to their direct_status fields, flushes the raw queue with THROWAWAY, passes 0xF0000000 to PADRecalibrate, and writes zero to reset_switch. PADRecalibrate merges pending work, excludes waiting/checking channels, updates reset/enabled masks, conditionally adds recalibration marks, and disables affected polling. Later origin acquisition depends on device type, spec, reset state and transfer success; fresh origins for every channel are not guaranteed.

facts.rationale: Preserves proven sequencing while separating requested rumble state from hardware command timing.
facts.value: Saves and disables interrupts, unconditionally removes scheduled rumble and clears each port's direct rumble request, discards buffered input, requests PAD recalibration, clears reset_switch, and restores the prior interrupt state. Motor command emission remains in the rumble interpreter. PADRecalibrate merges eligible reset work and invokes DoReset only when ResettingChan is idle.

facts.rationale: Maps the demonstrated controller reset effects without treating asynchronous or conditional driver behavior as guaranteed completion.
facts.value: Provides a four-controller software reset boundary: queued input and the reset-button latch are cleared, scheduled/direct force-feedback requests are removed, and the PAD driver receives an all-channel recalibration request. Immediate physical motor shutdown and newly acquired origins on every channel are not guaranteed by this routine.
